personas.name: Authorization and access-control attacker
personas.goal: Book, read, or change a trade you should not be allowed to touch.
techniques: cross-site request forgery on state-changing endpoints

personas.name: Injection attacker
personas.goal: Get attacker-controlled input interpreted as code, markup, or log structure anywhere downstream.

personas.name: Race-condition and replay attacker
personas.goal: Make one economic event settle twice or not at all.

personas.name: Business-logic abuser
personas.goal: Get a trade booked that a trade-support analyst would reject on sight.

personas.name: Third-party component attacker
personas.goal: Find an exploitable weakness in a library or server the service ships with.
techniques: resolve the real dependency versions from the Spring Boot BOM
match against CISA KEV and NVD
